notes:
### Added

- A Now Playing widget for your home screen: the cover, title and artist, a timeline, and repeat, previous, play/pause and next. Tap it to open the list that's playing, right where the current track is.
- Search forgives typos and puts the best matches first.
- Search finds tracks by their lyrics, and shows the matching line under each one.
- Tracks credited to several artists, like "A, B & C" or "A × B", now appear under each of those artists. In the player, tap a name to open that artist. This is on by default; turn it off under Settings > Content > Separate artists.
- Videos are listed with a widescreen thumbnail showing their length and how far you've watched, and with their quality and file size, like "1080p • 111.6 MB".

### Changed

- Smoother screen transitions and snappier button presses.
- The skip buttons now use skip icons instead of fast-forward and rewind icons.

### Fixed

- Titles, artists and albums whose tags were saved with the wrong text encoding now show their accented letters correctly: "Señorita" instead of "SeÃ±orita".
- In the tag editor, swiping back while typing only closes the keyboard and no longer asks you to discard your changes. The field you're editing stays visible above the keyboard.
- The top bar stays in place when the keyboard opens.
- Track properties show every detail at once instead of filling in one by one.
- While searching, the scroll button moves into the quick play button's place instead of leaving a gap.
